senses.gloss: f. (v. קיָּים) existence, duration, permanence (used in Hebr. dict.).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 4:1:2">Y. Yeb. IV, 5ᶜ</cite> <he>בן ק׳</he> a viable child.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 12:3">Ḥull. XII, 3</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 22:6">Deut. XXII, 6</cite>) <he>מה אפרוחים בני ק׳ אף בצים בני ק׳</he> as ‘the young’ means having vitality, so ‘the eggs’ must have vitality (by hatching).

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 2:3">Gitt. II, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Gittin 19a:4">19ᵃ</cite>) <he>דבר שהוא של ק׳</he> (Var. <he>רושם</he>) any ink which lasts (v. <cite ref="S00374"><he>קוּם</he></cite> h.); a. fr.
